Array Index Checker
25
Easy
Problem Statement
Given an array of n elements and an index, print the element at that index. Handle the case where the index is invalid using exception handling.
Description
Read an integer n, followed by n integers to fill an array, followed by an index value. Try to access the element at that index. If the index is invalid (negative or beyond the array bounds), catch the exception and print an error message instead of crashing.
Input Description
The first line contains an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100). The next n lines contain the array elements. The last line contains the index to access.
Output Description
Print the element at the given index. If the index is out of bounds, print "Error: Index out of bounds" instead.
